entities.summary: Demetrios Kydones, Latinized as Demetrius Cydones or Demetrius Cydonius, was a Byzantine Catholic theologian, translator, author and statesman. He served an unprecedented three terms as Mesazon of the Byzantine Empire under three successive emperors: John VI Kantakouzenos, John V Palaiologos and Manuel II Palaiologos.
